notes: Distinctive non-Telugu name, and it pinned down exactly as expected. The official CARE result title 'Best Cardiologist in Musheerabad | Dr. Johann Christopher | CARE Hospitals' sits on https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/hyderabad/care-super-specialty-hospital-musheerabad/johann-christopher-cardiologist - the Musheerabad branch slug 'care-super-specialty-hospital-musheerabad' matches the documented pattern precisely, and Gurunanak CARE Hospitals IS the Musheerabad campus (JustDial, Sehat and myUpchar all list him as 'Dr. Johann Christopher (Gurunanak Care Hospital), Musheerabad'). That gives name + specialty (cardiology) + branch + city + hospital, five factors, with no experience figure needed. LinkedIn is his own personal profile ('Johann Christopher - Greater Hyderabad Area', cardiac imaging) - not a company page - so it is recorded per Tier 2. ResearchGate surfaced on its own during a role query (affiliation shown as 'CARE Hospitals, Hyderabad | Division of Cardiology'), so it is recorded; I did not go hunting for ORCID/Scholar. CONTACTS DELIBERATELY LEFT BLANK: the only email trail anywhere was a ZoomInfo listing showing a MASKED '****@iaciind.org' address (Indian Association of Cardiac Imaging). ZoomInfo is a barred contact broker AND completing a masked address is explicitly forbidden, so nothing was recorded and no attempt was made to reconstruct it. For the same reason his claimed 'Executive Member, Indian Association of Cardiac Imaging' role is NOT recorded as a signal - it appeared only on broker pages; the 'Executive Member of the Asian Society of Cardiac Imaging' wording in hni_signals comes from the CARE profile instead. JustDial's number was rejected on sight as a call-tracking proxy, and CARE's central line was not recorded. Band is Medium, not High: carehospitals.com is one official source family, and LinkedIn (self-published) and ResearchGate/Practo/Vaidam/Skedoc/Credihealth (corroborating) cannot earn High. A 2025 SCMR Conference presenter page surfaced on his name but its title carries no name, so I could not confirm it is him and left it out - worth a human check, as SCMR faculty status would strengthen the profile further. He is the clearest high-net-worth candidate in this batch.
